result.reason: A numerical target-sigma root was found, but its physical cavity checks failed. No accepted cavity shape or volume is reported.
result.scope: Steady 2-D upper partial-sheet potential flow with algebraic pressure recovery and the existing smooth-contact/BV estimator. No viscous separation, cloud shedding, erosion or experimental accuracy qualification.

raw.reason: At the automatically selected detachment station, computed liquid still labelled wetted falls below vapour pressure. The numerical root is retained, but it is not a physically accepted cavity. No pressure or gap samples have been clipped.

physicalAdmissibility.reason: At the automatically selected detachment station, computed liquid still labelled wetted falls below vapour pressure. The numerical root is retained, but it is not a physically accepted cavity. No pressure or gap samples have been clipped.
physicalAdmissibility.criterion: Cp + sigma = (p - pv)/qInfinity >= 0 on every sampled wetted panel; cavity BC panels are excluded.
physicalAdmissibility.scope: Equilibrium partial-sheet model consistency screen. Sensitive to discretisation near detachment and closure; not an experiment, accuracy estimate or empirical calibration.

metrics.pressureNote: Pressure residual uses a local five-point derivative of solved total potential within each boundary region (fewer points if needed), with one-sided stencils at detachment and closure. It compares to an imposed BC, not an experiment.

raw.scope: Steady 2-D inviscid potential flow; prescribed upper partial-cavity length and detachment; algebraic pressure recovery; no re-entrant jet, viscosity, shedding, erosion or 3-D wing solution. Numerically verified prototype; cavitation predictions not experimentally validated.

provenance.formulation: Constant source/doublet mixed-potential BIE; cubic upstream detachment potential; independent wake jump and five-point total-velocity Kutta condition at adjacent TE collocation points; fixed-x nonlinear cavity updates.
provenance.closure: Pressure-recovery law retained. A is an additional unknown selected by a three-node derivative of the PHYSICAL gap h at the prescribed cavity end; a separate five-node derivative is reported. No endpoint value or pressure is replaced.

detachment.equationCount: 163 linear unknowns/rows per (shape, A, x_D) [velocity Kutta]; inner: m-1 node heights + qc <-> m kinematic rows with end-height closure; outer: A <-> h_x(x_E)=0 and x_D <-> beta(x_D)=0; sigma output.

smoothDetachment.rawReason: A wetted panel has Cp below -sigma by more than the declared pressure tolerance.
smoothDetachment.innerReason: Cavity equations and physical-gap endpoint regularity converged.
smoothDetachment.pressureGate: Core physicalAdmissibility; floating-point roundoff only. No null bypass or mesh-error allowance.
smoothDetachment.estimator: Default source cavity estimator: least-squares first FIVE interior approximate normal gaps against s^(3/2) and s^2 in original foil arclength. Four-/six-node windows and upstream speed are diagnostics.
smoothDetachment.limitation: Numerical candidate; not experimental validation or proof of a unique smooth cavity.

wetPreflight.criterion: Every wetted sample Cp + target sigma >= 0 (roundoff only), on both meshes; positive clearance must also exceed the observed minimum-Cp mesh change.
wetPreflight.limitation: Potential-flow consistency screen; not observed inception, hysteresis or a cavitation experiment.

targetSigmaScreen.reason: The computed wetted liquid falls below vapour pressure. The prescribed detachment and closure do not resolve that additional cavitation region; this branch is numerical only. Pressure has not been clipped and the cavity has not been moved.

targetSigmaScreen.scope: Equilibrium partial-sheet model consistency screen. Sensitive to discretisation near detachment and closure; not an experiment, accuracy estimate or empirical calibration.
